package studentcontext_test

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/usecase/studentcontext"
)

type actionContextReaderStub struct {
	snapshot domain.StudentLearningActionSnapshot
	err      error
}

func (stub actionContextReaderStub) GetLearningActionContext(
	context.Context,
	string,
	string,
) (domain.StudentLearningActionSnapshot, error) {
	return stub.snapshot, stub.err
}

type targetMasteryReaderStub struct {
	items   []domain.StudentTargetMastery
	err     error
	calls   int
	targets []domain.LearningTargetRef
}

type learnerOverviewReaderStub struct {
	overview domain.StudentLearnerOverview
	calls    int
}

type actionCodeContextReaderStub struct {
	context domain.StudentLearningActionCodeContext
	err     error
	calls   int
}

type practiceContextReaderStub struct {
	context domain.PracticeTaskContext
	err     error
	calls   int
}

func (stub *practiceContextReaderStub) GetPracticeTaskContext(context.Context, string, string) (domain.PracticeTaskContext, error) {
	stub.calls++
	return stub.context, stub.err
}

type practiceValidationReaderStub struct {
	context domain.PracticeTeacherValidationContext
	err     error
	calls   int
}

func (stub *practiceValidationReaderStub) GetPracticeTeacherValidationContext(
	_ context.Context,
	_ domain.PracticeTaskContext,
	_ string,
) (domain.PracticeTeacherValidationContext, error) {
	stub.calls++
	return stub.context, stub.err
}

func (stub *actionCodeContextReaderStub) GetLearningActionCodeContext(context.Context, string, string) (domain.StudentLearningActionCodeContext, error) {
	stub.calls++
	return stub.context, stub.err
}

func (stub *learnerOverviewReaderStub) GetLearnerOverview(context.Context, string) (domain.StudentLearnerOverview, error) {
	stub.calls++
	return stub.overview, nil
}

func (stub *targetMasteryReaderStub) GetTargetMastery(
	_ context.Context,
	_ string,
	targets []domain.LearningTargetRef,
) ([]domain.StudentTargetMastery, error) {
	stub.calls++
	stub.targets = append([]domain.LearningTargetRef(nil), targets...)
	return stub.items, stub.err
}

func TestBuildCreatesBoundedTaskContextFromFrozenTargets(t *testing.T) {
	studentID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	actionID := "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	first := domain.LearningTargetRef{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.errors", Version: "v1"}
	second := domain.LearningTargetRef{Type: domain.LearningTargetCapability, Key: "go.errors.wrap"}
	lastSeenAt := time.Date(2026, 8, 30, 10, 30, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	mastery := &targetMasteryReaderStub{items: []domain.StudentTargetMastery{
		{
			Target:                  first,
			State:                   domain.TargetMasteryApplied,
			MasteryScore:            1,
			Confidence:              0.33333,
			IndependentSuccessCount: 1,
			EvidenceCount:           1,
			LastSeenAt:              &lastSeenAt,
			PolicyVersion:           "student-mastery-v1",
		},
		{
			Target:        second,
			State:         domain.TargetMasteryUnknown,
			PolicyVersion: "student-mastery-v1",
		},
	}}
	useCase := studentcontext.Build{
		Actions: actionContextReaderStub{snapshot: domain.StudentLearningActionSnapshot{
			LearningActionID: actionID,
			StudentID:        studentID,
			TaskID:           "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
			ContextType:      domain.LearningContextLessonTask,
			ContextID:        "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
			LearningTargets:  []domain.LearningTargetRef{first, second},
			Status:           domain.LearningActionStatusOpen,
			OpenedAt:         time.Date(2026, 8, 30, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
		}},
		Mastery: mastery,
	}

	got, err := useCase.Execute(context.Background(), studentcontext.BuildInput{
		StudentID:        studentID,
		LearningActionID: actionID,
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, studentID, got.StudentID)
	require.Equal(t, actionID, got.LearningActionID)
	require.Equal(t, domain.LearningContextLessonTask, got.ContextType)
	require.Equal(t, []domain.LearningTargetRef{first, second}, got.LearningTargets)
	require.Equal(t, []domain.LearningTargetRef{first, second}, mastery.targets)
	require.Len(t, got.RelevantMastery, 2)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TargetMasteryApplied, got.RelevantMastery[0].State)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TargetMasteryUnknown, got.RelevantMastery[1].State)
}

func TestBuildCreatesGeneralContextFromBoundedLearnerOverview(t *testing.T) {
	studentID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	overview := &learnerOverviewReaderStub{overview: domain.StudentLearnerOverview{
		StudentID: studentID, Version: domain.StudentLearnerOverviewVersion,
		Onboarding: &domain.StudentOnboardingSnapshot{
			DirectionCode: "backend", SelfAssessedExperience: "basic",
			DesiredStacks: []string{"go"}, GoalCode: "first-job",
			PreferredLanguage: "ru", WeeklyMinutes: 300, PreferredPace: "balanced",
			ProfileVersion: "student-onboarding-v1", Version: 1,
		},
	}}
	useCase := studentcontext.Build{Overview: overview}
	got, err := useCase.Execute(context.Background(), studentcontext.BuildInput{
		StudentID: studentID, ContextType: domain.LearningContextGeneral,
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, domain.LearningContextGeneral, got.ContextType)
	require.NotNil(t, got.Onboarding)
	require.Equal(t, "backend", got.Onboarding.DirectionCode)
	require.Equal(t, 1, overview.calls)
}

func TestBuildCreatesLessonContextFromLearnerOverview(t *testing.T) {
	studentID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	lessonID := "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	overview := &learnerOverviewReaderStub{overview: domain.StudentLearnerOverview{
		StudentID: studentID, Version: domain.StudentLearnerOverviewVersion,
	}}
	got, err := (studentcontext.Build{Overview: overview}).Execute(
		context.Background(), studentcontext.BuildInput{
			StudentID: studentID, ContextType: domain.LearningContextLesson, ContextID: lessonID,
		},
	)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, domain.LearningContextLesson, got.ContextType)
	require.Equal(t, lessonID, got.ContextID)
	require.Equal(t, 1, overview.calls)
}

func TestBuildTargetlessActionDoesNotInventTargetsOrQueryMastery(t *testing.T) {
	mastery := &targetMasteryReaderStub{err: errors.New("must not be called")}
	useCase := studentcontext.Build{
		Actions: actionContextReaderStub{snapshot: validOpenSnapshot(nil)},
		Mastery: mastery,
	}

	got, err := useCase.Execute(context.Background(), studentcontext.BuildInput{
		StudentID:        "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
		LearningActionID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Empty(t, got.LearningTargets)
	require.Empty(t, got.RelevantMastery)
	require.Zero(t, mastery.calls)
}

func TestBuildAttachesBoundedCodeContextForTaskAction(t *testing.T) {
	snapshot := validOpenSnapshot(nil)
	code := &actionCodeContextReaderStub{context: domain.StudentLearningActionCodeContext{
		LearningActionID: snapshot.LearningActionID, StudentID: snapshot.StudentID, TaskID: snapshot.TaskID,
		Available: true, Files: []domain.StudentCodeFile{{Path: "main.go", Content: "package main"}},
		PolicyVersion: domain.StudentLearningActionCodeContextVersion,
		Validation:    domain.StudentValidationObservation{PolicyVersion: domain.SandboxValidationObservationVersion},
	}}
	result, err := (studentcontext.Build{
		Actions: actionContextReaderStub{snapshot: snapshot}, Code: code, Mastery: &targetMasteryReaderStub{},
	}).Execute(context.Background(), studentcontext.BuildInput{StudentID: snapshot.StudentID, LearningActionID: snapshot.LearningActionID})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, 1, code.calls)
	require.NotNil(t, result.CodeContext)
	require.Equal(t, "main.go", result.CodeContext.Files[0].Path)
}

func TestBuildRejectsClosedActionBeforeMasteryQuery(t *testing.T) {
	snapshot := validOpenSnapshot([]domain.LearningTargetRef{{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.errors"}})
	snapshot.Status = domain.LearningActionStatusClosed
	mastery := &targetMasteryReaderStub{}
	useCase := studentcontext.Build{Actions: actionContextReaderStub{snapshot: snapshot}, Mastery: mastery}

	_, err := useCase.Execute(context.Background(), studentcontext.BuildInput{
		StudentID:        snapshot.StudentID,
		LearningActionID: snapshot.LearningActionID,
	})
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrLearningActionClosed)
	require.Zero(t, mastery.calls)
}

func TestBuildFailsClosedOnMismatchedMasteryProjection(t *testing.T) {
	target := domain.LearningTargetRef{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.errors"}
	snapshot := validOpenSnapshot([]domain.LearningTargetRef{target})
	mastery := &targetMasteryReaderStub{items: []domain.StudentTargetMastery{{
		Target:        domain.LearningTargetRef{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.interfaces"},
		State:         domain.TargetMasteryUnknown,
		PolicyVersion: "student-mastery-v1",
	}}}
	useCase := studentcontext.Build{Actions: actionContextReaderStub{snapshot: snapshot}, Mastery: mastery}

	_, err := useCase.Execute(context.Background(), studentcontext.BuildInput{
		StudentID:        snapshot.StudentID,
		LearningActionID: snapshot.LearningActionID,
	})
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrInvalidStudentContext)
}

func TestBuildPropagatesStudentDependencyFailure(t *testing.T) {
	useCase := studentcontext.Build{
		Actions: actionContextReaderStub{err: domain.ErrStudentStateUnavailable},
		Mastery: &targetMasteryReaderStub{},
	}
	_, err := useCase.Execute(context.Background(), studentcontext.BuildInput{
		StudentID:        "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
		LearningActionID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
	})
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrStudentStateUnavailable)
}

func TestBuildAddsAvailableTeacherValidationOnlyToPracticeTask(t *testing.T) {
	practice := validPracticeContextForBuild("practice")
	validation := validPracticeValidationForBuild(practice)
	practiceReader := &practiceContextReaderStub{context: practice}
	validationReader := &practiceValidationReaderStub{context: validation}
	result, err := (studentcontext.Build{
		Practice: practiceReader, PracticeValidation: validationReader, Mastery: &targetMasteryReaderStub{},
	}).Execute(context.Background(), studentcontext.BuildInput{
		StudentID: practice.StudentID, LearningActionID: practice.LearningActionID,
		ContextType: domain.LearningContextPracticeTask, ContextID: practice.TaskInstanceID,
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotNil(t, result.PracticeValidation)
	require.Equal(t, validation.SubmissionID, result.PracticeValidation.SubmissionID)
	require.Equal(t, 1, validationReader.calls)
}

func TestBuildTreatsTeacherValidationDependencyAndUnavailableAsOptional(t *testing.T) {
	practice := validPracticeContextForBuild("practice")
	for name, reader := range map[string]*practiceValidationReaderStub{
		"dependency":  {err: domain.ErrStudentStateUnavailable},
		"unavailable": {context: domain.PracticeTeacherValidationContext{Available: false}},
	} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			result, err := (studentcontext.Build{
				Practice: &practiceContextReaderStub{context: practice}, PracticeValidation: reader, Mastery: &targetMasteryReaderStub{},
			}).Execute(context.Background(), studentcontext.BuildInput{
				StudentID: practice.StudentID, LearningActionID: practice.LearningActionID,
				ContextType: domain.LearningContextPracticeTask, ContextID: practice.TaskInstanceID,
			})
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.Nil(t, result.PracticeValidation)
		})
	}
}

func TestBuildFailsClosedOnCorruptTeacherValidationProjection(t *testing.T) {
	practice := validPracticeContextForBuild("practice")
	_, err := (studentcontext.Build{
		Practice:           &practiceContextReaderStub{context: practice},
		PracticeValidation: &practiceValidationReaderStub{err: domain.ErrInvalidStudentContext},
		Mastery:            &targetMasteryReaderStub{},
	}).Execute(context.Background(), studentcontext.BuildInput{
		StudentID: practice.StudentID, LearningActionID: practice.LearningActionID,
		ContextType: domain.LearningContextPracticeTask, ContextID: practice.TaskInstanceID,
	})
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrInvalidStudentContext)
}

func TestBuildDoesNotReadTeacherValidationForProject(t *testing.T) {
	practice := validPracticeContextForBuild("project")
	validationReader := &practiceValidationReaderStub{err: errors.New("must not be called")}
	result, err := (studentcontext.Build{
		Practice: &practiceContextReaderStub{context: practice}, PracticeValidation: validationReader, Mastery: &targetMasteryReaderStub{},
	}).Execute(context.Background(), studentcontext.BuildInput{
		StudentID: practice.StudentID, LearningActionID: practice.LearningActionID,
		ContextType: domain.LearningContextProject, ContextID: practice.TaskInstanceID,
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Nil(t, result.PracticeValidation)
	require.Zero(t, validationReader.calls)
}

func validPracticeContextForBuild(surface string) domain.PracticeTaskContext {
	return domain.PracticeTaskContext{
		Schema:           domain.PracticeTaskContextSchemaV1,
		TaskInstanceID:   "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		StudentID:        "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
		TaskRevisionID:   "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		LearningActionID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		Surface:          surface, Locale: "ru", Status: "ACTIVE",
		Step: domain.PracticeTaskStepContext{ID: "implement", Title: "Implement", Objective: "Build", Status: "AVAILABLE"},
		AssistancePolicy: domain.PracticeTaskAssistancePolicy{
			Version: 1, MaxHintLevel: 2,
			Teacher: domain.PracticeTeacherPolicy{MayExplain: true},
		},
	}
}

func validPracticeValidationForBuild(practice domain.PracticeTaskContext) domain.PracticeTeacherValidationContext {
	submissionID := "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555"
	digest := "sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"
	updatedAt := time.Date(2026, 9, 5, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	passed := false
	return domain.PracticeTeacherValidationContext{
		Schema: domain.PracticeTeacherValidationContextSchemaV1, Available: true,
		TaskInstanceID: practice.TaskInstanceID, StudentID: practice.StudentID,
		TaskRevisionID: practice.TaskRevisionID, LearningActionID: practice.LearningActionID,
		SubmissionID: &submissionID, WorkspaceDigest: &digest, UpdatedAt: &updatedAt, Passed: &passed,
		TeacherExplanation: &domain.TeacherValidationExplanation{
			Schema: domain.TeacherValidationExplanationSchemaV1, BlockingIssues: []domain.TeacherValidationIssue{},
			SourceDigest: "sha256:bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb",
		},
	}
}

func validOpenSnapshot(targets []domain.LearningTargetRef) domain.StudentLearningActionSnapshot {
	return domain.StudentLearningActionSnapshot{
		LearningActionID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		StudentID:        "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
		TaskID:           "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		ContextType:      domain.LearningContextPracticeTask,
		ContextID:        "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		LearningTargets:  targets,
		Status:           domain.LearningActionStatusOpen,
		OpenedAt:         time.Date(2026, 8, 30, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
	}
}
